profileEvidence.summary: Haiden C. Trigg prized speed, scenting ability and the willingness to range in his foxhounds. He described running red foxes to earth or catching them and wrote that feeding the pack himself helped him gain their affection. His Kentucky strain grew from Birdsong and Maupin dogs; a 2000 keeper account describes Trigg hounds competing in organized hunts.
